speaker: penny
text: What do you mean, transgressions I've committed?

speaker: sheldon_cooper
text: Were you under the impression that Leonard has no complaints about you?

speaker: penny
text: Like what? Yeah, yeah, I see you, you're making a little cheque sign in the air, I got it, just hold your horses. What does Leonard complain about?

speaker: sheldon_cooper
text: Your driving, the plethora of stuffed animals on your bed that stare at him during your amorous activities, your constant tardiness, your singing. That's actually from my list, but Leonard would be a fool if he didn't agree with it.

speaker: penny
text: My singing?

speaker: penny
text: Okay, if Leonard has so many problems with me, why hasn't he just said so?

speaker: sheldon_cooper
text: Because, according to him, you're oversensitive and have a temper.

speaker: penny
text: Oh, really? Well, then, do me a favour and tell Leonard that he can drop dead!

speaker: sheldon_cooper
text: And she wonders why she's constantly undertipped.

speaker: leonard_hofstadter
text: Hey.

speaker: sheldon_cooper
text: Oh, good, you're home. I need you to do me a favour. Go apologize to Penny.

speaker: leonard_hofstadter
text: Sure.

speaker: leonard_hofstadter
text: What?

speaker: sheldon_cooper
text: Right now would be good.

speaker: penny
text: Leonard!

speaker: sheldon_cooper
text: Although, a few minutes ago would have been better.

speaker: penny
text: I hear you don't like my stuffed animals, my driving or my punctuality.

speaker: leonard_hofstadter
text: What? Who would tell you something like that? Why would you tell her something like that?

speaker: penny
text: It doesn't matter why he told me. It's true, isn't it?

speaker: leonard_hofstadter
text: Okay, yeah, it's true, but I can live with that stuff. What I can't live with is you casually informing me that some guy's going to be staying in your apartment without even asking me first!

speaker: penny
text: That isn't even your problem, the problem is you don't trust me!

speaker: leonard_hofstadter
text: Oh, come on. Sheldon, have you ever once heard me say that I don't trust Penny? Sheldon? Where did he go?

speaker: penny
text: Oh, your yelling must have freaked him out again.

speaker: leonard_hofstadter
text: Where are you going? You just walk away in the middle of an argument?!

speaker: penny
text: No, I'm going to go find your damn roommate before he hurts himself trying to cross the street or something!

speaker: leonard_hofstadter
text: Why didn't you say so?

speaker: penny
text: Oh, now I need your permission for that, too?!

speaker: leonard_hofstadter
text: Well, I can't read your mind, Penny!

speaker: penny
text: Really? Why not? You're so smart, and I'm so dumb!

speaker: sheldon_cooper
text: Raj. Raj. Raj.

speaker: raj_koothrappali
text: Stop knocking! It's open! Please tell my parents that our dark matter research is at a critical juncture, and I can't come home for my cousin Sanjay's wedding.

speaker: mrs_koothrappali
text: Sheldon, ask our son what we're supposed to say to Mr. and Mrs. Choudhry, whose daughter, Lakshmi is flying in from London, for the sole purpose of meeting him.

speaker: raj_koothrappali
text: I didn't ask you to set me up with Lakshmi.

speaker: mrs_koothrappali
text: You should be thanking us!

speaker: dr_vm_koothrappali
text: Yes, Lakshmi just got her stomach stapled. You have an opportunity to get in good with her before she loses weight, and her self-esteem goes up.

speaker: raj_koothrappali
text: I don't care! And why don't you think I can find a woman for myself?

speaker: mrs_koothrappali
text: Because you're 27, and the closest thing we have to a daughter-in-law is that Jewish boy Howard.

speaker: raj_koothrappali
text: Oh, that is completely below the belt. Sheldon, tell my parents that Howard and I are just friends. Sheldon? Howard and I are just friends!
